document.description: The document's title, as a person would cite it.

title.description: A person's title for the document, in place of the one read from it (document:), which a re-read writes again: kb:ingest and kb:refresh keep this one. Callers hear it, an answer cites it, and its approval holds it. Default: document.

url.description: Where it was read from on the web.

file.description: The file it was read from.

crawl.description: For a page read by a crawl (pnpm kb:ingest <url>): the crawl's settings, which pnpm kb:refresh crawls with again.

start.description: The page the crawl started from.

depth.description: How many links from the start page it read.

include.description: The globs over URL paths it was narrowed to.

rateMs.description: The least time between two requests to a host, in milliseconds.

summarize.description: false: no section of it is ever answered from by summarizing (kb.yaml documents), and it needs no approval for it: for a document that is only the source of passages (a certificate, a policy). Default: it may be summarized once a person approves it for that.

applies.description: Which callers an answer summarized from it is for (kb.yaml documents), as a passage's applies: for each fact in kb.yaml's applies, a value or a list of values. Default: every caller.

approval.description: Who approved the document for summarizing (kb.yaml documents: on), when, and the hash of what they approved. Written by pnpm kb:approve --document, which also logs it in kb/approvals.jsonl; pnpm check refuses an approval with no line there.

hash.description: SHA-256 of everything approved: the document's id, title and applies, and each section's id, heading, text and whether it may be summarized. A changed word makes it differ, and the document is withheld until it is approved again.

heading.description: The section's heading in the document.

text.description: The section's text, as the document has it. Approvals hash it (whitespace collapsed), so a changed word makes its passages stale.

page.description: For a document with pages (a PDF): the page the section starts on. Provenance only: approvals do not hash it.

lastPage.description: For a section that runs on past its first page: the page it ends on. Provenance only.

summarize.description: false: never answered from by summarizing (kb.yaml documents), whatever the document's approval: for what a document says that should not be said to a caller. Default: summarized where no passage cites it.

sections.description: The document's sections, by id (a number like "3.2" or a short name).

description: kb/sources/<doc>.yaml: one source document's text by section.
title: DialogWright kb/sources/<doc>.yaml
